name: Truth, safety, and characterization
objective: Freeze current behavior, repair P0 documentation/security drift, and generate a trustworthy baseline.
exit_gate: Current LAN behavior is tested; documented commands and paths exist; unsafe secret guidance is removed.

name: Modular server and typed contracts
objective: Split transport, policy, stores, and evidence behind versioned schemas.
exit_gate: Legacy UI works through modular services and all security characterization tests pass.

name: Canonical document and read-only import
objective: Create stable IDs, revisions, migrations, and React/router/CSS read projections.
exit_gate: Repeated imports are idempotent and stable without source mutation.

name: Command journal and local mutations
objective: Move mutations into typed transactions with undo, redo, replay, and semantic diff.
exit_gate: Journal replay produces the expected document hash and authorization/revision tests pass.

name: React Designer UI migration
objective: Replace monolithic UI internals with an accessible typed React shell.
exit_gate: All current LAN flows operate in the new UI with keyboard and visual-regression coverage.

name: Structural source editing
objective: Support constrained AST-backed page/node operations in the current template.
exit_gate: Supported structural edits rebuild, undo, re-import, and retain stable object identity.

name: Style, variables, and responsive engine
objective: Implement standards-aligned cascade, breakpoints, states, tokens, Grid, Flex, and output adapters.
exit_gate: Effective styles match browser fixtures and source output is deterministic and reversible.

name: Components and libraries
objective: Add definitions, instances, props, slots, variants, dependencies, versions, and migrations.
exit_gate: Component changes produce impact reports; instances round-trip and upgrade safely.

name: CMS, bindings, forms, and assets
objective: Build typed data-driven authoring and emulator-first provider adapters.
exit_gate: A CMS page and form work end-to-end through emulators with rules and accessibility tests.

name: Interactions and localization
objective: Add trigger/target/timeline motion and sparse locale overrides.
exit_gate: A page/component supports reusable motion and two locales without duplicating the document.

name: Snapshots, publishing, backup, and restore
objective: Connect immutable preview/release manifests to existing SYSTEMX gates.
exit_gate: An approved snapshot publishes deterministically and a prior release restores with evidence.

name: Extensions, CLI, and MCP
objective: Expose bounded platform clients over the shared query/command kernel.
exit_gate: A sandboxed extension and read-only MCP client work; approved mutation uses the journal.

name: Collaboration, insights, and domain packs
objective: Add comments, presence, branches, analytics overlays, experiments, and optional commerce.
exit_gate: Page branch review/merge is conflict-aware and release evidence remains complete.
